newsitem.title: FRENCH GUIANA: Second night of violence in French Guiana.
newsitem.headline: Second night of violence in French Guiana.

text.p: A second night of rioting and violence shook the city of Cayenne in French Guiana early on Saturday, witnesses said.
Witnesses said shops and homes were damaaged in the rioting during which police and looters clashed for the second consecutive night.
The police fired teargas and chased youths armed with rocks and Molotov cocktails in the capital of the French overseas territory on the northeast coast of South America.
On Friday, officials said millions of dollars of damage was caused to government buildings and shops during rioting sparked by a strike of high school students.
The students, who barricaded French government officials in the Cayenne Prefecture for several hours, were protesting against poor conditions in their schools.
Pierre Dartout, the French administrator of French Guiana described the riots on Friday as premeditated and "very serious."
Dozens of riot police now surround the Cayenne prefecture building in anticipation of fresh attacks, witnesses said.
